from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,torch
assert torch.version.hip is None and torch.cuda.device_count()==1
assert torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)==(12,1)
assert torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0]>1<<30
torch.set_num_threads(2)
x=torch.arange(65536,dtype=torch.int32).to(torch.int16).view(torch.bfloat16).cuda()
y=torch.sigmoid(x)
torch.cuda.synchronize()
data=y.cpu().view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes()
assert len(data)==131072 and torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()<64<<20
with Path('/work/torch-sigmoid-bf16.bin').open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
report=dict(torch_version=torch.__version__,device=list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0)),inputs=65536,bytes=len(data),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),maximum_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),model_loaded=False,inference_acceptance=False)
with Path('/work/capture.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(report))
